{
  "dataset_name": "microaggregation2",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "group1_ordinal_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of the first ordinal block (a1-a5), capturing aggregate level on the 1-5 scale.",
      "value_range": [5.0, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth additive projection useful for linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "a1 + a2 + a3 + a4 + a5"
    },
    {
      "name": "group2_ordinal_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of the second ordinal block (a6-a10), capturing aggregate level on the 1-5 scale.",
      "value_range": [5.0, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "linear_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth additive projection useful for linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "a6 + a7 + a8 + a9 + a10"
    },
    {
      "name": "ordinal_block_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed difference between the two ordinal blocks, measuring asymmetry.",
      "value_range": [-20.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "contrast",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a signed linear contrast feature SVMs can weight directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(a1 + a2 + a3 + a4 + a5) - (a6 + a7 + a8 + a9 + a10)"
    },
    {
      "name": "ordinal_block_abs_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute discrepancy between matched ordinal positions across the two blocks.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "dissimilarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous severity measure of block disagreement for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(a1 - a6) + np.abs(a2 - a7) + np.abs(a3 - a8) + np.abs(a4 - a9) + np.abs(a5 - a10)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_continuous_block1_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p-transformed sum of the first continuous block (a11-a15) to compress heavy tails.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "log_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooths heavy-tailed inputs for stable linear/SVM weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(a11 + a12 + a13 + a14 + a15)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_continuous_block2_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p-transformed sum of the second continuous block (a16-a20) to compress heavy tails.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "log_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooths heavy-tailed inputs for stable linear/SVM weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(a16 + a17 + a18 + a19 + a20)"
    },
    {
      "name": "continuous_block_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of continuous block sums (block1 over block2), clipped to a stable range.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures relative magnitude between blocks as a smooth projectable score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((a11 + a12 + a13 + a14 + a15) / (a16 + a17 + a18 + a19 + a20 + 1e-6), 0.0, 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "continuous_log_abs_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of log-scale absolute differences between paired continuous attributes across blocks.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "dissimilarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Robust severity measure of cross-block deviation for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(np.log1p(a11) - np.log1p(a16)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a12) - np.log1p(a17)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a13) - np.log1p(a18)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a14) - np.log1p(a19)) + np.abs(np.log1p(a15) - np.log1p(a20))"
    },
    {
      "name": "ordinal_monotonicity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Counts how many adjacent ordinal pairs are non-decreasing within block 1, normalized to [0,1].",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "structural",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes structural monotonicity as a smooth normalized score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(a2 >= a1, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(a3 >= a2, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(a4 >= a3, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(a5 >= a4, 1.0, 0.0)) / 4.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "tail_magnitude_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average log magnitude of the heaviest-tailed continuous attributes (a15 and a20).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a stable extreme-value indicator beneficial for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(a15) + np.log1p(a20)) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "ordinal_continuous_alignment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how well the ordinal block levels align with the continuous block magnitudes; computed as correlation-style alignment between normalized ordinal mean and normalized log continuous mean.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_alignment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures cross-block coherence as a smooth bounded judgment score for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "row_dispersion_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic semantic judgment of within-row heterogeneity across all 20 attributes; high values indicate diverse profile, low values indicate uniform profile.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_dispersion",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth bounded dispersion judgment complements linear features for margin shaping.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
